description: How the ~20 most recent US IPOs have traded SINCE debut: against offer, against first close, days listed and the lockup estimate. Upcoming deals are not here, they are in get_events_calendar.

include_history.description: Include each deal's [unix_seconds, close] series since debut. Default false.

min_market_cap.description: Minimum market cap in USD dollars to include. Default 2e9 ($2B). Deals with an unknown (null) market cap are always kept.

top.description: Most-recent N deals to return. Default 20 of the ~6-month book (~150 deals); a `truncated` block reports what was cut.

name: get_ipo_performance
